description.value: The Buffet is a full-service buffet restaurant inside Cascades Casino Delta, offering weekend brunch, themed dinner nights, and a rotating array of international specialties. It sits within a large casino-hotel complex that includes multiple dining venues, a spa, and conference facilities. As a destination buffet in a casino resort, it is well-suited for a hungry touring cyclist looking for a substantial all-you-can-eat meal.
